snippet.title: Corsairs – Battle of the Caribbean – Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play one of the 5 factions and pursue its ambitions. Who will you choose? Corsairs: Battle of the Caribbean, available on May 18 2026!

Sail to glory in Corsairs: Battle of the Caribbean! 🌊 Take on the role of a privateer and serve your nation to gain fame and wealth. Explore treacherous seas, build a powerful fleet and fight epic battles against enemy ships.

Wishlist the game now!
On Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2397510/Corsairs__Battle_of_the_Caribbean/ 
On Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/corsairs-da268e
On GOG: https://www.gog.com/en/game/corsairs_battle_of_the_caribbean

--
🚢 Caribbean adventure:
Your journey will take you to the exotic islands of the West Indies, where you'll discover hidden treasures, recruit crew members and fight for Caribbean supremacy. Choose to represent one of the great maritime powers: French, Danish, Spanish, British or Dutch.

⚓ Immersive gameplay:
Experience the real life of a pirate with vast seas of possibilities. Combine tactical combat with management gameplay, and intelligently manage your fleet to defend your trading positions. Enjoy an enhanced progression system, new soldier types and an expanded campaign mode for an immersive experience.

⚓ Game features:
- Intense Naval Battles: Command a fleet of 17 different ships, each with its own unique capabilities, and use 3 types of ammunition with distinct effects.
- Trade and Management: Master the mechanics of trade, wisely manage your fleet and cities, and defend your trading positions.
- Upgrades and Quests: Upgrade your ships and strengthen your crew by earning resources through quests and exploring new territories.
- Varied Soldiers: Use 3 types of soldier - Tank, Gunner and Agile - to strengthen your crew.
- Expanded Campaign Mode: Immerse yourself in a new campaign added to the four captivating original scenarios.
- Revamped Boarding Mode: Discover different soldier classes and a Captain who can take part in battles.

Climb aboard, sailor, and make your mark on maritime history in Corsairs: Battle of the Caribbean! ⚔️🦜

🔔 Subscribe for more videos and don't miss a single pirate adventure!
